_about: What the PROJECT PROPOSAL / PROFILE task page shows. One file per form (user, 2026-10-07): change this file to change what the page shows - no code change. Read by IRSTasks through the `fields` key of the subtype's entry in js/config/TaskFields.js.
_generated: Generated on 2026-10-07 from IRSProjects/js/config/ProjectForm.js, whose source of truth is WP02 doc 05 section 12 - every field verified in MQL on 2026-09-23. Hand edits are expected from now on; if doc 05 changes, check both this file and ProjectForm.js.

_source.project: read from the PROJECT's dataelements - the proposal form is almost entirely project data, which is why this page calls the project
_source.task: read from the TASK's own dataelements (this form has none - EPMPROJECT_PROPOSAL carries no custom attribute, measured 2026-10-07)
_source.none: not a value: it lives in a relationship, in its own objects, in the WBS or in the approval route. The page shows the note instead of an empty box, because an empty box reads as 'nothing was entered'.

_display.longtext: prose - the form asks for paragraphs here
_display.pending: agreed but NOT created on the platform yet: the page says so rather than showing it as empty
_display.elsewhere: see the note - another object or tab owns it
_display.approval: an approval signature - a route task, not a field
_display.type: carried by the project's type itself
